notes_for_editor: NO STORY WRITTEN (held). No readable public source gives this lookout's build year, builder, staffing history, fate or current site. The only lookout-specific readable source is the Canada Lookouts index entry, which places it under the Peace River Division (cite 2). Cites 3 and 4 are system-wide context and would be padding in a site history. Cite 1 is a place-name match: Clear Hills County exists, but nothing read ties this lookout to it. PROTECTED DATA: the record's built year (2012), height (24 m), elevation, coordinates, access note and staffing come only from the Alberta WF_WILDFIRE_LOOKOUT layer. Its metadata (data/raw/expansion/prairies-north/ab_lookout_layer0_meta.json) marks the layer Protected and says the features are not to be shown on maps at 1:1,000,000 or larger, or on maps with local roads that the general public will see. None of those values is used in these research notes. The record says staffed March to October; the public Alberta page says generally April to October. Leads not readable: a Reddit r/firelookouts post titled 'Clear Hills Fire Lookout, Peace River Country, Alberta, 2004' (blocked to both fetch_text and WebFetch); a Provincial Archives of Alberta record 'Peterson, A.H.; Clear Hills, Alberta' in the Fire Commissioner's Branch series (1919-1935), which redirected with no text.
